verdict.line: You lose if Volibear forces trades level 1-3 off his point-and-click stun; you win if you dodge Thundering Smash and snowball with Conqueror once R comes online.

brief.thesis: Volibear's Q (Thundering Smash) is a 300-range dash that stuns the first thing he attacks, so he picks the trade timing for the entire early game and Riven has no ability that avoids it once he commits. The matchup hinges on whether Riven can survive levels 1-6 without eating a free Q-W-auto sequence, because her own stun (W, Ki Burst) and dash-shield (E, Valor) are too short-range to contest his initiation.

theirWindow.when: His Q is up and you're within 300 range
theirWindow.what: He can dash-stun you for free and chain W (Frenzied Maul) twice plus autos before you can react. Stay outside 300 range or behind minions until you see the Q used on a wave.

yourWindow.when: His Q is on cooldown (10-12s) and your E/W are up
yourWindow.what: This is your only real window to engage. Use E (Valor) to close the gap safely, land W (Ki Burst) to stun, and dump Q (Broken Wings) charges before he can reset with his W heal.

start.why: Picked in 87.6% of games (49.1% win rate over 825 games) because the extra sustain and AD let you survive early Thundering Smash trades without falling behind on CS.

boots.why: 55.6% pick rate (50.7% win rate over 495 games) — the ability haste shortens your E and W cooldowns so you have more windows to punish between his Q resets.

core.why: The shield and burst let you survive his W-W heal combo while trading back; part of the 67.4% win rate path over 43 games.
Damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through his delayed Frenzied Maul heal and sustained trades.
Sustain and scaling damage to offset his innate healing on W, core to the 61-67% win rate paths.

runes.keystoneWhy: OP.GG's own tip for this matchup is to keep Conqueror stacks up — the adaptive force and healing from stacks offset Volibear's sustain advantage once you're forced into extended trades.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 93.9% of games at 48.6% win rate — Ignite punishes his Frenzied Maul heal directly, cutting off his main sustain tool in trades.

playing.title: Never stand in his Q range idle
playing.detail: Thundering Smash has 300 range and stuns on contact — walk through minions or stay behind your wave so he can't get a free dash-stun on you.

playing.title: Trade only when his Q is down
playing.detail: His Q is on a 10-12s cooldown; track it after every use so you know exactly when it's safe to step up and use your own E (Valor) to engage.

playing.title: Punish double-W casts
playing.detail: His W (Frenzied Maul) deals bonus damage and heals him on the second cast on the same target — if you see him go for the second W, disengage with E rather than trading through it.

playing.title: Save Q charges for his E
playing.detail: Sky Splitter is a 1200-range skillshot with a 16s cooldown — if he throws it at range, use Broken Wings charges to close the gap fast rather than walking it down.

playing.title: All-in around level 6 only with cooldowns up
playing.detail: His ultimate grants bonus health and he can leap in defensively — only commit your R (Blade of the Exile) when your W and E are both available to chain stun into disengage.

playing.title: Ignite his healing on every real trade
playing.detail: Since his kit leans on W sustain, landing Ignite before an extended trade removes his main way of winning the exchange.

playing.title: Look to snowball from level 11 on
playing.detail: Once Blade of the Exile is online, your burst outpaces his sustain — this is where the 48.1% head-to-head win rate starts tilting in your favor if you've survived to this point.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (796-game Riven vs Volibear sample); the tactical reasoning — when to trade, what to track, how the power curve shifts — is my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit by Volibear’s (E) ability. Keep your Conqueror’s stacks up and engage with your abilities.
